inventory.item: Step 4: grep for raw businessDate/dueAt/updatedAt-style fields reaching JSX directly (bypassing formatIsoDate/formatIsoDateTime)
inventory.note: shared/lib/date.ts defines formatIsoDate/formatIsoDateLong/formatIsoDateTime specifically to convert 'YYYY-MM-DD' (or full ISO timestamp) fields to ru-RU display format. Multiple JSX sites still interpolate the raw field value directly instead of calling the helper — see findings RAW-20260823-0001 through -0007. The sweep referenced in Status.md ('форматирование дат... сырой ISO больше не печатается') is PARTIAL, not complete: it covers events registry table and a few other spots (app/security-ops/events/page.tsx correctly calls formatIsoDate at lines 325 and 330), but several other screens (persons, objects/[id], command-center, analytics x2, analytics/operations) were missed.

findings.title: Raw ISO date string (businessDate) interpolated directly into JSX, bypassing formatIsoDate

recommendation.text: Call formatIsoDate(event.businessDate) instead of interpolating event.businessDate raw — the helper exists in shared/lib/date.ts precisely to avoid printing 'YYYY-MM-DD' unlocalized strings to end users; the same file's events/page.tsx already does this correctly for the same field.

findings.title: Raw ISO date (verificationDueAt) interpolated into a user-facing sentence, bypassing formatIsoDate

recommendation.text: `Срок очередной проверки — ${freshness.verificationDueAt}.` should read `Срок очередной проверки — ${formatIsoDate(freshness.verificationDueAt)}.` — the sibling list page (app/security-ops/objects/page.tsx FreshnessCell) already formats the same field correctly via a local formatDate() helper.

findings.title: Raw ISO date (businessDate) interpolated into command-center 'upcoming events' list

recommendation.text: Replace `{event.businessDate} · {event.objectName}` with `{formatIsoDate(event.businessDate)} · {event.objectName}`. Note the same file already correctly extracts just the day via `.slice(8, 10)` at line 287 for a different display, showing the raw-value habit is inconsistent within the same component.
